sections.title: Reasoning
sections.body: Sunday July 27. The operation is effectively at a standstill on the trading side. No trades executed today across any agent or manual account. Lens ran at some point before 17:42 UTC and produced a macro bias report — that was the only productive agent activity. The bias is notable: SPX500 bullish at 62%, US OIL sharply bearish at 72% on the back of a US-Iran military pause collapsing WTI ~6%. BTC and gold are both sitting at neutral. Sentinel is flashing strong buy signals on UUUU, IREN, and USAR (4-5 buy signals each) and a regular buy on IONQ — these are worth monitoring for manual entries given the risk-on pivot. Crisp-v5 is intentionally stopped and being repurposed — not an error. Edge service is inactive; its portfolio data is 61 days stale as of today (last sync May 27). Blade has zero trades since the July 17 clean-slate reset and no usable data for grading. Jerry has been formally graded a FAIL by the validator: 116 trades, 35.3% win rate, profit factor 0.972, negative expectancy of -$5.17 per trade, max drawdown 13.4%. Jerry is bleeding. Chad cannot be graded — only 6 usable trades. Net worth snapshot: checking $676.95, Truist MMA $9,500, Robinhood $12,953.70, Kraken crypto $13,446.40 (XRP/ETH/SOL/LINK), TrustWallet $1.20. Total approximately $38,578. Tao staking: zero TAO staked, zero invested, 5 DCA entries available. The week opens with macro tailwinds for equities but the trading infrastructure is not positioned to capture any of it.
